missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend vitamin K solely for a bone-health goal; review diet, existing products and relevant medicines.
safety_exclusions: Do not claim vitamin K supplementation prevents or treats osteoporosis based only on a wellness goal.
Do not overlook warfarin/vitamin K antagonist interactions.
Do not alter prescribed osteoporosis or anticoagulant treatment.
professional_escalation_conditions: Warfarin or other vitamin K antagonist, bleeding/thrombotic history, osteoporosis treatment or planned procedure.
population_and_context: People selecting bone health as a goal; a general wellness goal does not establish vitamin K deficiency or prove benefit from supplemental vitamin K.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Assess dietary intake and medication interactions; follow clinician guidance for anticoagulation.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Vitamin K fact sheet provides intake and interaction context; bone-health outcomes and supplementation claims require separate appraisal.
